notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.5.8 — Runs that carry on

• Run again works after a run that already started building: a new attempt of a Work Item carries its adopted plan on (no new council, the plan revalidated if the repository moved) instead of stopping with "the implementer was already launched … under an earlier owner". This also covers a run interrupted by an app update. A crash still never launches the same build twice.
• Big test suites no longer hold the planning up: your tests run in the background while the Coordinator and the Council plan, and the build starts with their result.
• Datadog Error Tracking syncs: when its answer isn't cut short, Datadog sends the issues as a plain YAML list without its usual tags, which Vekrun now reads too (checked against the answer a debug report kept).
• Production monitoring reads Sentry, Honeybadger and AppSignal answers as tolerantly as Datadog's (tables, YAML, JSON with words around it), and an answer it still can't read leaves a redacted sample in the debug report instead of a guess.
• A ticket in the Board's queue opens on the Board's Tickets tab, with its description formatted.
